Joined my friends with @FloridaRetail this morning at ICAST in Orlando—the largest fishing trade show in the world.

We got to stop by and visit with some incredible Florida-based businesses that are driving innovation, creating jobs, and strengthening our economy.

As the Fishing Capital of the World, Florida’s fishing industry is an important part of our economy, and we’ll keep working to ensure it continues to thrive.

posts.text: I’m honored to earn the endorsement of the Florida Retail Federation. Florida’s retailers are the backbone of our economy, creating jobs, serving our communities and helping families thrive. As governor, I’ll continue fighting to keep taxes low, reduce burdensome regulations and ensure Florida remains the best place in America to start a business, grow a business and create opportunity for generations to come. @FloridaRetail

Back in Union County tonight with @Kat_Cammack after a full day of votes in Washington.

There’s no place I’d rather be than back home in Florida meeting with each and every one of you.

posts.text:
Medicine that costs $50 in other countries costs Floridians $200. I’m fighting back.

In Congress, I fought for Most Favored Nation pricing, securing lower prices for Americans.

As Governor, I won’t stop fighting for lower prescription medicine costs until every Floridian can afford the medicine they need.

Florida’s citrus industry is central to our economy and identity. 

We are not only synonymous with the orange — growers work day-in and day-out to export grapefruit, tangerines and other citrus products across the nation and the world.

I’m honored to earn the endorsement of Florida Citrus Mutual and will always advocate for citrus growers and the entire agricultural community.
